_comment: D59 (PROVISIONAL — canonical-by-design, pending sandbox re-pin): the shape a completed order takes when the PLATFORM settled shipping, so PIS sent it as its own Type 'Shipping' order line instead of a seeded AvailableShippingMethods entry. The distinguishing property vs qliro-get-order-response.completed.v1.json is the ABSENT Metadata block: Metadata is Qliro's record of a selection the customer made in the widget, and here the customer made none — the line's own MerchantReference carries the platform's method code. Everything downstream (completion-time shipping-price guard, the methodReference echoed to the module) must therefore work off the line itself; see QliroGetOrderSettledShippingTests.
